	VehicleBuilder.luau

	Gương chiếu hậu, Đèn pha/hậu, Cánh gió sau, Biển số San Andreas, Mâm hợp kim & Heo dầu phanh).
	MỖI BỘ PHẬN VỎ XE ĐỀU CÓ MÁU ẨN (PartHealth) — Bị súng bắn hoặc đâm xe sẽ sẫm màu/nứt và tự bung vỡ!
]]

local function weldTo(root: BasePart, part: BasePart): WeldConstraint
	local wc = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	wc.Name = "PanelWeld"
	wc.Part0 = root
	wc.Part1 = part
	wc.Parent = part
	return wc
end

local function makeCarPart(spec: {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	chassis: BasePart,
	localCF: CFrame,
	size: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	transparency: number?,
	hp: number?, -- nil => khung gầm lõi không vỡ rời (tính vào EngineHealth)
	zone: string?, -- "Front" | "Rear" | "Left" | "Right" | "Top" | "Glass"
	isWedge: boolean?,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
}): BasePart
	local inst: BasePart
	if spec.isWedge then
		inst = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	else
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		if spec.shape then
			p.Shape = spec.shape
		end
		inst = p
	end

	inst.Name = spec.name
	inst.Size = spec.size
	inst.CFrame = spec.chassis.CFrame * spec.localCF
	inst.Color = spec.color
	inst.Material = spec.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	inst.Transparency = spec.transparency or 0
	inst.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	inst.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	inst.Anchored = false
	inst.Massless = true
	inst.CanCollide = if spec.canCollide ~= nil then spec.canCollide else false
	inst.CanQuery = true
	inst.CanTouch = true

	if spec.hp ~= nil then
		inst:SetAttribute("Destructible", true)
		inst:SetAttribute("VehiclePart", true)
		inst:SetAttribute("MaxPartHealth", spec.hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("PartHealth", spec.hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("MaxIntegrity", spec.hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("Integrity", spec.hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("DamageZone", spec.zone or "Body")
	else
		inst:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
	end

	inst.Parent = spec.parent
	weldTo(spec.chassis, inst)
	return inst
end

function VehicleBuilder.spawn(parent: Instance, spawnCF: CFrame, trim: VehicleTrim): Model
	local car = Instance.new("Model")
	car.Name = trim.modelName
	car:SetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle", true)
	car:SetAttribute("VehicleDisplayName", trim.modelName)
	car:SetAttribute("MaxEngineHealth", 700)
	car:SetAttribute("EngineHealth", 700)

	chassis.CanCollide = true

	car.PrimaryPart = chassis

		name = "CabinTub",

	driverSeat.Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 34)

	plateNum.Text = "46GTV88"
	plateNum.Parent = plateGui

	-- 4. BỐN CỤM BÁNH XE VẬT LÝ HÌNH CẦU LEO VỈA HÈ MƯỢT + LỐP CAO SU & MÂM HỢP KIM
	local wheelsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	wheelsFolder.Name = "Wheels"
	wheelsFolder.Parent = car

	local wheelSpecs = {
		{ name = "FL", x = -3.18, z = -4.95 },
		{ name = "FR", x = 3.18, z = -4.95 },
		{ name = "RL", x = -3.18, z = 4.95 },
		{ name = "RR", x = 3.18, z = 4.95 },
	}
	for _, ws in ipairs(wheelSpecs) do
		local sideSign = if ws.x < 0 then -1 else 1
		-- Khối cầu vật lý vô hình đường kính 3.3 studs giúp xe lăn êm qua bó vỉa 0.65 stud & bậc cầu thang!
		local ball = Instance.new("Part")
		ball.Name = "WheelCollider_" .. ws.name
		ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		ball.Size = Vector3.new(3.3, 3.3, 3.3)
		ball.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(ws.x * 0.86, -0.4, ws.z)
		ball.Transparency = 1
		ball.CanCollide = true
		ball.CanQuery = false
		ball.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		ball.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		ball.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(1.4, 0.08, 0.02, 100, 1)
		ball:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
		ball.Parent = wheelsFolder
		weldTo(chassis, ball)

		-- Lốp cao su đen & Mâm hợp kim (PartType.Cylinder có trục lăn dọc trục X cục bộ -> KHÔNG xoay Z 90 độ!)
		local tire = Instance.new("Part")
		tire.Name = "Tire_" .. ws.name
		tire.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		tire.Size = Vector3.new(1.12, 2.86, 2.86)
		tire.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(ws.x, -0.60, ws.z)
		tire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 28)
		tire.Material = Enum.Material.Rubber
		tire.CanCollide = false
		tire.Massless = true
		tire:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
		tire.Parent = wheelsFolder
		weldTo(chassis, tire)

		local rim = Instance.new("Part")
		rim.Name = "Rim_" .. ws.name
		rim.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		rim.Size = Vector3.new(1.18, 1.90, 1.90)
		rim.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(ws.x + sideSign * 0.02, -0.60, ws.z)
		rim.Color = trim.rimColor
		rim.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		rim.Reflectance = 0.22
		rim.CanCollide = false
		rim.Massless = true
		rim:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
		rim.Parent = wheelsFolder
		weldTo(chassis, rim)

		for _, spokeAng in ipairs({ 0, 45, 90, 135 }) do
			local spoke = Instance.new("Part")
			spoke.Name = "Spoke_" .. ws.name
			spoke.Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 1.72, 0.18)
			spoke.CFrame = chassis.CFrame
				* CFrame.new(ws.x + sideSign * 0.59, -0.60, ws.z)
				* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(spokeAng), 0, 0)
			spoke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 48)
			spoke.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
			spoke.CanCollide = false
			spoke.Massless = true
			spoke:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
			spoke.Parent = wheelsFolder
			weldTo(chassis, spoke)
		end

		local caliper = Instance.new("Part")
		caliper.Name = "BrakeCaliper_" .. ws.name
		caliper.Size = Vector3.new(0.22, 0.64, 0.40)
		caliper.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(ws.x + sideSign * 0.26, -0.44, ws.z - 0.48)
		caliper.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 36, 36)
		caliper.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		caliper.CanCollide = false
		caliper.Massless = true
		caliper:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
		caliper.Parent = wheelsFolder
		weldTo(chassis, caliper)
	end

	-- 5. GẮN BỘ ĐỘNG LỰC VẬT LÝ (Attachment + VectorForce + AngularVelocity) ĐỂ LÁI SIÊU MƯỢT
	local rootAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	rootAtt.Name = "DriveAttachment"
	rootAtt.Parent = chassis

	local driveForce = Instance.new("VectorForce")
	driveForce.Name = "DriveVectorForce"
	driveForce.Attachment0 = rootAtt
	driveForce.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	driveForce.Force = Vector3.zero
	driveForce.Parent = chassis

	local steerVel = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
	steerVel.Name = "SteerAngularVelocity"
	steerVel.Attachment0 = rootAtt
	steerVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	steerVel.MaxTorque = 0
	steerVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	steerVel.Parent = chassis

	return car
end

-- Đội xe GTA V đậu sẵn quanh Quảng trường Legion Square & Đại lộ trung tâm
function VehicleBuilder.spawnDefaultFleet(losSantosRoot: Instance): Folder
	local existing = losSantosRoot:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles")
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end

	local fleetFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	fleetFolder.Name = "Phase2_Vehicles"
	fleetFolder.Parent = losSantosRoot

	local spots = {
		-- Ngay sảnh Nam Quảng trường Legion Square (cách điểm Spawn vài bước chân!)
		{
			cf = CFrame.new(-24, 0.55, 139) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), 0),
			preset = VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.CrimsonBanshee,
		},
		-- Đậu sát lề đường San Andreas Ave cạnh rào cọc tiêu Legion Square
		{
			cf = CFrame.new(-99, 0.55, 78) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0),
			preset = VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.ObsidianGauntlet,
		},
		-- Đậu dọc Đại lộ trung tâm Olympic Fwy (gần dải phân cách K-Rail để test đâm xe!)
		{
			cf = CFrame.new(-36, 0.55, -25) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), 0),
			preset = VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.MidnightBanshee,
		},
		-- Đậu sát lối đi bộ biển Vespucci Blvd
		{
			cf = CFrame.new(42, 0.55, 139) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0),
			preset = VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.SunsetComet,
		},
	}

	for idx, sp in ipairs(spots) do
		local v = VehicleBuilder.spawn(fleetFolder, sp.cf, sp.preset)
		v:SetAttribute("SpawnSlotIndex", idx)
	end

	return fleetFolder
end

return VehicleBuilder

local function isInsideIntersection(x: number, z: number, axis: "X" | "Z", margin: number): boolean
	if axis == "X" then
		for _, ns in ipairs(WorldGrid.NS_ROADS) do
			if math.abs(x - ns.coord) <= (ns.width * 0.5 + margin) then
				return true
			end
		end
	else
		for _, ew in ipairs(WorldGrid.EW_ROADS) do
			if math.abs(z - ew.coord) <= (ew.width * 0.5 + margin) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- ============================================================================
local function buildRoadInfrastructure(parent: Instance)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "01_RoadInfrastructure"
	folder.Parent = parent

	-- A. 3 Đại lộ Đông - Tây
	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.EW_ROADS) do
		local len = r.max - r.min
		local cx = (r.min + r.max) * 0.5

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = r.id .. "_Roadbed",
			parent = folder,
			pos = Vector3.new(cx, 0, r.coord),
			size = Vector3.new(len, 1.0, r.width),
			color = COLORS.ASPHALT_BASE,
			material = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
		})

		-- Vệt mòn lốp xe thực tế trên từng làn + Rãnh bê tông thoát nước sát mép vỉa hè (Gutter)
		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "TireWearStrip",
				parent = folder,
				pos = Vector3.new(cx, 0.505, r.coord + side * (r.width * 0.23)),
				size = Vector3.new(len - 8, 0.02, 5.2),
				color = COLORS.ASPHALT_WEAR,
				material = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
				canCollide = false,
				castShadow = false,
			})
			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "ConcreteGutterEW",
				parent = folder,
				pos = Vector3.new(cx, 0.508, r.coord + side * (r.width * 0.5 - 0.7)),
				size = Vector3.new(len, 0.03, 1.4),
				color = COLORS.GUTTER,
				material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				canCollide = false,
				castShadow = false,
			})
		end

		local cursor = r.min + 8
		while cursor <= r.max - 8 do
			if not isInsideIntersection(cursor, r.coord, "X", 7.5) then
				for _, offsetZ in ipairs({ -0.6, 0.6 }) do
					PartBuilder.part({
						name = "DoubleYellow",
						parent = folder,
						pos = Vector3.new(cursor, 0.52, r.coord + offsetZ),
						size = Vector3.new(11.8, 0.05, 0.36),
						color = COLORS.YELLOW_LINE,
						material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
						canCollide = false,
						castShadow = false,
					})
				end

				-- Đinh phản quang mặt đường California (Botts' Dots) cách đều 24 studs
				if math.floor((cursor - r.min) / 12) % 2 == 0 then
					PartBuilder.part({
						name = "BottsDot",
						parent = folder,
						pos = Vector3.new(cursor, 0.54, r.coord),
						size = Vector3.new(0.42, 0.08, 0.42),
						color = COLORS.YELLOW_LINE,
						material = Enum.Material.Neon,
						canCollide = false,
						castShadow = false,
					})
				end

				if r.lanes >= 4 and (math.floor((cursor - r.min) / 12) % 2 == 0) then
					local laneOff = r.width * 0.25
					for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
						PartBuilder.part({
							name = "LaneDash",
							parent = folder,
							pos = Vector3.new(cursor, 0.52, r.coord + side * laneOff),
							size = Vector3.new(7.5, 0.05, 0.35),
							color = COLORS.WHITE_LINE,
							material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
							canCollide = false,
							castShadow = false,
						})
					end
				end
			end
			cursor += 12
		end
	end

	-- Dải phân cách bê tông K-Rail (Jersey Barriers — Destructible = true!) dọc Đại lộ Olympic Fwy (Z = -36)
	local medianSpans = {
		{ name = "OlympicMedian_West", minX = -296, maxX = -138 },
		{ name = "OlympicMedian_Center", minX = -82, maxX = 82 },
		{ name = "OlympicMedian_East", minX = 138, maxX = 296 },
	}
	for _, sp in ipairs(medianSpans) do
		PartBuilder.jerseyBarrierRun({
			name = sp.name,
			parent = folder,
			axis = "X",
			fixedCoord = -36,
			minCoord = sp.minX,
			maxCoord = sp.maxX,
			baseY = 0.5,
			segmentLength = 14,
			fractureGroup = sp.name,
		})
	end

	-- B. 4 Đại lộ Bắc - Nam đối xứng
	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.NS_ROADS) do
		local len = r.max - r.min
		local cz = (r.min + r.max) * 0.5

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = r.id .. "_Roadbed",
			parent = folder,
			pos = Vector3.new(r.coord, 0, cz),
			size = Vector3.new(r.width, 1.0, len),
			color = COLORS.ASPHALT_BASE,
			material = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
		})

		for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "TireWearStripNS",
				parent = folder,
				pos = Vector3.new(r.coord + side * (r.width * 0.23), 0.505, cz),
				size = Vector3.new(5.2, 0.02, len - 8),
				color = COLORS.ASPHALT_WEAR,
				material = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
				canCollide = false,
				castShadow = false,
			})
			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "ConcreteGutterNS",
				parent = folder,
				pos = Vector3.new(r.coord + side * (r.width * 0.5 - 0.7), 0.508, cz),
				size = Vector3.new(1.4, 0.03, len),
				color = COLORS.GUTTER,
				material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				canCollide = false,
				castShadow = false,
			})
		end

		local cursor = r.min + 8
		while cursor <= r.max - 8 do
			if not isInsideIntersection(r.coord, cursor, "Z", 7.5) then
				for _, offsetX in ipairs({ -0.6, 0.6 }) do
					PartBuilder.part({
						name = "DoubleYellow",
						parent = folder,
						pos = Vector3.new(r.coord + offsetX, 0.52, cursor),
						size = Vector3.new(0.36, 0.05, 11.8),
						color = COLORS.YELLOW_LINE,
						material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
						canCollide = false,
						castShadow = false,
					})
				end

				if math.floor((cursor - r.min) / 12) % 2 == 0 then
					PartBuilder.part({
						name = "BottsDotNS",
						parent = folder,
						pos = Vector3.new(r.coord, 0.54, cursor),
						size = Vector3.new(0.42, 0.08, 0.42),
						color = COLORS.YELLOW_LINE,
						material = Enum.Material.Neon,
						canCollide = false,
						castShadow = false,
					})
				end

				if r.lanes >= 4 and (math.floor((cursor - r.min) / 12) % 2 == 0) then
					local laneOff = r.width * 0.25
					for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
						PartBuilder.part({
							name = "LaneDash",
							parent = folder,
							pos = Vector3.new(r.coord + side * laneOff, 0.52, cursor),
							size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.05, 7.5),
							color = COLORS.WHITE_LINE,
							material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
							canCollide = false,
							castShadow = false,
						})
					end
				end
			end
			cursor += 12
		end
	end

	-- C. 12 Ngã tư chuẩn kỹ thuật + Song chắn rác thoát nước mưa + Vạch đi bộ Zebra
	for _, ew in ipairs(WorldGrid.EW_ROADS) do
		for _, ns in ipairs(WorldGrid.NS_ROADS) do
			local ix, iz = ns.coord, ew.coord
			local hw, hd = ns.width * 0.5, ew.width * 0.5

			PartBuilder.part({
				name = string.format("Intersection_%s_%s", ew.id, ns.id),
				parent = folder,
				pos = Vector3.new(ix, 0.015, iz),
				size = Vector3.new(ns.width, 1.0, ew.width),
				color = COLORS.INTERSECTION,
				material = Enum.Material.Asphalt,
			})

			-- Nắp cống tròn/vuông trung tâm + 2 song chắn rác kim loại sát mép cống ngã tư
			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "ManholeCover",
				parent = folder,
				pos = Vector3.new(ix + 2.2, 0.525, iz - 2.2),
				size = Vector3.new(2.8, 0.05, 2.8),
				color = COLORS.DRAIN_GRATE,
				material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate,
				canCollide = false,
				castShadow = false,
			})
			for _, sxSign in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				PartBuilder.part({
					name = "StormDrainGrate",
					parent = folder,
					pos = Vector3.new(ix + sxSign * (hw - 0.8), 0.52, iz + sxSign * (hd + 8.5)),
					size = Vector3.new(1.3, 0.04, 3.4),
					color = COLORS.DRAIN_GRATE,
					material = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate,
					canCollide = false,
					castShadow = false,
				})
			end

			for _, dirZ in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				local cz = iz + dirZ * (hd + 3.2)
				local stripeX = ix - hw + 3.0
				while stripeX <= ix + hw - 3.0 do
					PartBuilder.part({
						name = "CrosswalkNS",
						parent = folder,
						pos = Vector3.new(stripeX, 0.525, cz),
						size = Vector3.new(1.7, 0.05, 5.2),
						color = COLORS.WHITE_LINE,
						material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
						canCollide = false,
						castShadow = false,
					})
					stripeX += 3.8
				end
				PartBuilder.part({
					name = "StopLineNS",
					parent = folder,
					pos = Vector3.new(ix, 0.525, iz + dirZ * (hd + 6.6)),
					size = Vector3.new(ns.width - 3.2, 0.05, 0.72),
					color = COLORS.WHITE_LINE,
					material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
					canCollide = false,
					castShadow = false,
				})
			end

			for _, dirX in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				local cx = ix + dirX * (hw + 3.2)
				local stripeZ = iz - hd + 3.0
				while stripeZ <= iz + hd - 3.0 do
					PartBuilder.part({
						name = "CrosswalkEW",
						parent = folder,
						pos = Vector3.new(cx, 0.525, stripeZ),
						size = Vector3.new(5.2, 0.05, 1.7),
						color = COLORS.WHITE_LINE,
						material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
						canCollide = false,
						castShadow = false,

					stripeZ += 3.8
				end
				PartBuilder.part({
					name = "StopLineEW",
					parent = folder,
					pos = Vector3.new(ix + dirX * (hw + 6.6), 0.525, iz),
					size = Vector3.new(0.72, 0.05, ew.width - 3.2),
					color = COLORS.WHITE_LINE,
					material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
					canCollide = false,
					castShadow = false,
				})
			end
		end

function CityFoundation.build(forceRebuild: boolean?): Model
	local legacy = Workspace:FindFirstChild("InteractiveCity")
	if legacy then
		legacy:Destroy()
	end
	local defaultBaseplate = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
	if defaultBaseplate and defaultBaseplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		defaultBaseplate:Destroy()
	end

	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos") :: Model?
	if root and not forceRebuild then
		if root:FindFirstChild("Phase1_CityFoundation") then
			return root
		end
	end

	if not root then
		local newRoot = Instance.new("Model")
		newRoot.Name = "LosSantos"
		newRoot.Parent = Workspace
		root = newRoot
	end

	local existingPhase1 = (root :: Model):FindFirstChild("Phase1_CityFoundation")
	if existingPhase1 then
		existingPhase1:Destroy()
	end

	local phase1 = Instance.new("Folder")
	phase1.Name = "Phase1_CityFoundation"
	phase1.Parent = root

	configureGoldenHourLighting()
	buildVespucciCoastline(phase1)
	buildSculptedVinewoodHills(phase1)
	buildRoadInfrastructure(phase1)
	buildSidewalksAndLots(phase1)

	return root :: Model
end

return CityFoundation

PartBuilder.source:
--!strict
--[[
	PartBuilder.luau (Modular Destructible Voxel Engine)
	Bộ công cụ dựng hình chuẩn hóa cho toàn bộ thế giới GTA V Los Santos:
	- Mọi khối tường, dải phân cách, bồn đá, lan can, cọc chắn và công trình về sau đều tạo từ
	  các khối vật lý rời có gắn Attribute:
	    + Destructible (boolean)
	    + MaxIntegrity / Integrity (number)
	    + FractureGroup (string)
	    + StructuralRow (number: tầng kết cấu từ dưới lên để tính sập dây chuyền)
]]

local PartBuilder = {}

export type PartSpec = {
	name: string?,
	parent: Instance,
	size: Vector3,
	pos: Vector3?,
	cframe: CFrame?,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	transparency: number?,
	reflectance: number?,
	canCollide: boolean?,
	castShadow: boolean?,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	destructible: boolean?,
	integrity: number?,
	fractureGroup: string?,
	structuralRow: number?,
}

export type MasonryWallSpec = {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	axis: "X" | "Z", -- Tường chạy dọc trục X (từ min -> max tại fixedCoord Z) hoặc trục Z
	fixedCoord: number,
	minCoord: number,
	maxCoord: number,
	baseY: number,
	thickness: number,
	courses: number,
	courseHeight: number,
	blockLength: number,
	mortarGap: number?,
	baseColor: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	colorJitter: number?,
	integrity: number?,
	fractureGroup: string,
	addCoping: boolean?,
	copingColor: Color3?,
}

export type StaircaseSpec = {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	origin: Vector3, -- Tâm chân bậc đầu tiên (ở cao độ thấp)
	dir: Vector3, -- Hướng bước lên: Vector3.new(0,0,-1), (0,0,1), (1,0,0), (-1,0,0)
	width: number,
	steps: number,
	totalRise: number,
	totalRun: number,
	color: Color3,
	cheekColor: Color3?,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	fractureGroup: string?,
}

local function applyDestructionTags(
	inst: BasePart,
	destructible: boolean?,
	integrity: number?,
	group: string?,
	row: number?
)
	local isDest = if destructible ~= nil then destructible else false
	inst:SetAttribute("Destructible", isDest)
	if isDest then
		local hp = integrity or 100
		inst:SetAttribute("MaxPartHealth", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("PartHealth", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("MaxIntegrity", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("Integrity", hp)
		inst:SetAttribute("FractureGroup", group or "WorldProp")
		inst:SetAttribute("StructuralRow", row or 1)
	end
end

local function tintColor(base: Color3, seedA: number, seedB: number, jitter: number): Color3
	local h = ((seedA * 73856093 + seedB * 19349663) % 29) - 14
	local delta = (h / 14.0) * (jitter / 255.0)
	return Color3.new(
		math.clamp(base.R + delta, 0, 1),
		math.clamp(base.G + delta, 0, 1),
		math.clamp(base.B + delta * 0.85, 0, 1)
	)
end

function PartBuilder.part(spec: PartSpec): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = spec.name or "Part"
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if spec.shape then
		p.Shape = spec.shape
	end
	p.Size = spec.size
	if spec.cframe then
		p.CFrame = spec.cframe
	elseif spec.pos then
		p.Position = spec.pos
	end
	p.Color = spec.color
	p.Material = spec.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Transparency = spec.transparency or 0
	p.Reflectance = spec.reflectance or 0
	if spec.canCollide ~= nil then
		p.CanCollide = spec.canCollide
	end
	if spec.castShadow ~= nil then
		p.CastShadow = spec.castShadow
	end
	applyDestructionTags(p, spec.destructible, spec.integrity, spec.fractureGroup, spec.structuralRow)
	p.Parent = spec.parent
	return p
end

function PartBuilder.wedge(spec: PartSpec): WedgePart

-- Dựng mảng tường đá / gạch / bê tông ghép so le từng viên vật lý độc lập (Running-Bond Destructible Masonry)
function PartBuilder.masonryWall(spec: MasonryWallSpec): Folder
	local wallFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	wallFolder.Name = spec.name
	wallFolder.Parent = spec.parent

	local gap = spec.mortarGap or 0.08
	local mat = spec.material or Enum.Material.Concrete
	local jitter = spec.colorJitter or 7
	local hp = spec.integrity or 130
	local totalLen = spec.maxCoord - spec.minCoord
	if totalLen <= 0.2 then
		return wallFolder
	end

	for row = 1, spec.courses do
		local cy = spec.baseY + (row - 0.5) * spec.courseHeight
		local actualH = math.max(0.15, spec.courseHeight - gap * 0.6)
		local stagger = if (row % 2 == 0) then (spec.blockLength * 0.5) else 0

		local cursor = spec.minCoord
		local colIdx = 1
		while cursor < spec.maxCoord - 0.05 do
			local targetLen = if colIdx == 1 and stagger > 0 then stagger else spec.blockLength
			local segEnd = math.min(spec.maxCoord, cursor + targetLen)
			local segLen = segEnd - cursor
			if segLen < 0.8 and cursor > spec.minCoord then
				break
			end
			local drawLen = math.max(0.4, segLen - gap)
			local mid = (cursor + segEnd) * 0.5

			local pos = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(mid, cy, spec.fixedCoord)
				else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, cy, mid)
			local sz = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(drawLen, actualH, spec.thickness)
				else Vector3.new(spec.thickness, actualH, drawLen)

			PartBuilder.part({
				name = string.format("Block_R%d_C%d", row, colIdx),
				parent = wallFolder,
				pos = pos,
				size = sz,
				color = tintColor(spec.baseColor, row + math.floor(spec.fixedCoord), colIdx, jitter),
				material = mat,
				destructible = true,
				integrity = hp,
				fractureGroup = spec.fractureGroup,
				structuralRow = row,
			})

			cursor = segEnd
			colIdx += 1
		end
	end

	if spec.addCoping then
		local topY = spec.baseY + spec.courses * spec.courseHeight + 0.16
		local capW = spec.thickness + 0.36
		local capStep = spec.blockLength * 1.25
		local cur = spec.minCoord
		local idx = 1
		while cur < spec.maxCoord - 0.05 do
			local nxt = math.min(spec.maxCoord, cur + capStep)
			local ln = math.max(0.5, (nxt - cur) - gap)
			local mid = (cur + nxt) * 0.5
			local pos = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(mid, topY, spec.fixedCoord)
				else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, topY, mid)
			local sz = if spec.axis == "X"
				then Vector3.new(ln, 0.32, capW)
				else Vector3.new(capW, 0.32, ln)

			PartBuilder.part({
				name = "CopingStone_" .. tostring(idx),
				parent = wallFolder,
				pos = pos,
				size = sz,
				color = spec.copingColor or Color3.fromRGB(204, 200, 192),
				material = Enum.Material.Sandstone,
				destructible = true,
				integrity = math.floor(hp * 0.85),
				fractureGroup = spec.fractureGroup,
				structuralRow = spec.courses + 1,
			})
			cur = nxt
			idx += 1
		end
	end

	return wallFolder
end

-- Dựng dải phân cách bê tông K-Rail (California Jersey Barrier) từng đốt rời có thể húc văng
function PartBuilder.jerseyBarrierRun(spec: {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	axis: "X" | "Z",
	fixedCoord: number,
	minCoord: number,
	maxCoord: number,
	baseY: number,
	segmentLength: number?,
	fractureGroup: string,
}): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = spec.name
	folder.Parent = spec.parent

	local segLen = spec.segmentLength or 13.5
	local gap = 0.45
	local cur = spec.minCoord
	local idx = 1

	while cur + 2.0 <= spec.maxCoord do
		local nxt = math.min(spec.maxCoord, cur + segLen)
		local drawL = (nxt - cur) - gap
		local mid = (cur + nxt) * 0.5
		local unitGroup = string.format("%s_Seg%d", spec.fractureGroup, idx)

		local basePos = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(mid, spec.baseY + 0.45, spec.fixedCoord)
			else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, spec.baseY + 0.45, mid)
		local baseSz = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(drawL, 0.9, 2.2)
			else Vector3.new(2.2, 0.9, drawL)

		local topPos = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(mid, spec.baseY + 1.45, spec.fixedCoord)
			else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, spec.baseY + 1.45, mid)
		local topSz = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(drawL, 1.15, 1.1)
			else Vector3.new(1.1, 1.15, drawL)

		local col = tintColor(Color3.fromRGB(168, 172, 178), idx, 7, 5)
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "KRailBase_" .. tostring(idx),
			parent = folder,
			pos = basePos,
			size = baseSz,
			color = col,
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 240,
			fractureGroup = unitGroup,
			structuralRow = 1,
		})
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "KRailSpine_" .. tostring(idx),
			parent = folder,
			pos = topPos,
			size = topSz,
			color = col,
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 210,
			fractureGroup = unitGroup,
			structuralRow = 2,
		})

		-- Miếng phản quang vàng trên đỉnh mỗi đốt dải phân cách cao tốc
		local reflPos = if spec.axis == "X"
			then Vector3.new(mid, spec.baseY + 2.08, spec.fixedCoord)
			else Vector3.new(spec.fixedCoord, spec.baseY + 2.08, mid)
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "KRailReflector_" .. tostring(idx),
			parent = folder,
			pos = reflPos,
			size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.14, 0.45),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 192, 42),
			material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			canCollide = false,
			castShadow = false,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 40,
			fractureGroup = unitGroup,
			structuralRow = 3,
		})

		cur = nxt
		idx += 1
	end

	return folder
end

-- Dựng hàng cọc thép chống đâm xe trên vỉa hè / quảng trường (húc bay từng cọc như GTA V!)
function PartBuilder.bollardLine(spec: {
	name: string,
	parent: Instance,
	startPos: Vector3,
	endPos: Vector3,
	count: number,
	fractureGroup: string,
}): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = spec.name
	folder.Parent = spec.parent

	for i = 0, math.max(0, spec.count - 1) do
		local alpha = if spec.count <= 1 then 0.5 else (i / (spec.count - 1))
		local p = spec.startPos + (spec.endPos - spec.startPos) * alpha
		local grp = string.format("%s_Bollard%d", spec.fractureGroup, i + 1)

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "BollardPost_" .. tostring(i + 1),
			parent = folder,
			pos = Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + 1.35, p.Z),
			size = Vector3.new(0.75, 2.7, 0.75),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 47, 56),
			material = Enum.Material.Metal,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 75,
			fractureGroup = grp,
			structuralRow = 1,
		})
		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "BollardRing_" .. tostring(i + 1),
			parent = folder,
			pos = Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y + 2.35, p.Z),
			size = Vector3.new(0.82, 0.22, 0.82),
			color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 46),
			material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			canCollide = false,
			castShadow = false,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 50,
			fractureGroup = grp,
			structuralRow = 2,
		})
	end

	return folder
end

-- Dựng bậc tam cấp / cầu thang đi bộ thật (mỗi bậc là 1 khối độc lập)
function PartBuilder.staircase(spec: StaircaseSpec): Folder
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = spec.name
	folder.Parent = spec.parent

	local riser = spec.totalRise / spec.steps
	local tread = spec.totalRun / spec.steps
	local mat = spec.material or Enum.Material.Sandstone
	local isZ = math.abs(spec.dir.Z) > 0.5

	for s = 1, spec.steps do
		local stepH = s * riser
		local offset = (s - 0.5) * tread
		local pos = Vector3.new(
			spec.origin.X + spec.dir.X * offset,
			spec.origin.Y + stepH * 0.5,
			spec.origin.Z + spec.dir.Z * offset
		)
		local sz = if isZ
			then Vector3.new(spec.width, stepH, tread + 0.15)
			else Vector3.new(tread + 0.15, stepH, spec.width)

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "Step_" .. tostring(s),
			parent = folder,
			pos = pos,
			size = sz,
			color = tintColor(spec.color, s, 3, 4),
			material = mat,
			destructible = false,
		})
	end

	-- 2 thành lan can đá thấp hai bên cầu thang (Destructible = true)
	local midOffset = spec.totalRun * 0.5
	for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local cheekPos = if isZ
			then Vector3.new(spec.origin.X + side * (spec.width * 0.5 + 0.65), spec.origin.Y + spec.totalRise * 0.55, spec.origin.Z + spec.dir.Z * midOffset)
			else Vector3.new(spec.origin.X + spec.dir.X * midOffset, spec.origin.Y + spec.totalRise * 0.55, spec.origin.Z + side * (spec.width * 0.5 + 0.65))
		local cheekSz = if isZ
			then Vector3.new(1.3, spec.totalRise + 1.1, spec.totalRun + 0.8)
			else Vector3.new(spec.totalRun + 0.8, spec.totalRise + 1.1, 1.3)

		PartBuilder.part({
			name = "StairCheekWall_" .. tostring(side),
			parent = folder,
			pos = cheekPos,
			size = cheekSz,
			color = spec.cheekColor or Color3.fromRGB(168, 164, 156),
			material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			destructible = true,
			integrity = 160,
			fractureGroup = (spec.fractureGroup or spec.name) .. "_Cheek" .. tostring(side),
			structuralRow = 1,
		})
	end

	return folder
end

-- Bia mốc quy hoạch nhỏ gọn ở lối vào ô đất (thay cho tấm bảng đen to thô giữa đất)
function PartBuilder.surveyMonument(
	parent: Instance,
	pos: Vector3,
	codeText: string,
	subText: string,
	accentColor: Color3?
): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "SurveyMonument_" .. codeText
	f.Parent = parent

	PartBuilder.part({
		name = "MonumentBase",
		parent = f,
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 0.45, pos.Z),
		size = Vector3.new(11.5, 0.9, 2.2),
		color = Color3.fromRGB(156, 160, 168),
		material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
		destructible = true,
		integrity = 140,
		fractureGroup = "Monument_" .. codeText,
		structuralRow = 1,
	})

	local signBoard = PartBuilder.part({
		name = "MonumentBoard",
		parent = f,
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y + 2.1, pos.Z),
		size = Vector3.new(10.6, 2.5, 0.9),
		color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 30, 40),
		material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		destructible = true,
		integrity = 100,
		fractureGroup = "Monument_" .. codeText,
		structuralRow = 2,
	})

	for _, face in ipairs({ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back }) do
		local sgui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		sgui.Face = face
		sgui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
		sgui.PixelsPerStud = 36
		sgui.LightInfluence = 0.15
		sgui.Parent = signBoard

		local topStripe = Instance.new("Frame")
		topStripe.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0)
		topStripe.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor or Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 46)
		topStripe.BorderSizePixel = 0
		topStripe.Parent = sgui

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.44)
		title.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.14)
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
		title.TextScaled = true
		title.TextColor3 = accentColor or Color3.fromRGB(245, 198, 46)
		title.Text = codeText
		title.Parent = sgui

		local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sub.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.3)
		sub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.6)
		sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		sub.TextScaled = true
		sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 228, 238)
		sub.Text = subText
		sub.Parent = sgui
	end

	return f
end

return PartBuilder

--!strict

	VINEWOOD_Z_MAX = -240,
	BEACH_BOARDWALK_Z_MIN = 164,
	BEACH_SAND_Z_MIN = 186,
	OCEAN_WATER_Z_MIN = 250,
}

-- Điểm hồi sinh chính giữa Quảng Trường Trung Tâm Legion Square (nhìn thẳng về Downtown & Đồi Vinewood)
WorldGrid.SPAWN_POS = Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 92)

function WorldGrid.getLocationInfo(pos: Vector3): (string, string)
	local district = "LOS SANTOS"

	if pos.Z < WorldGrid.ZONES.VINEWOOD_Z_MAX then
		district = "VINEWOOD HILLS"
	elseif pos.Z >= WorldGrid.ZONES.OCEAN_WATER_Z_MIN then
		district = "PACIFIC OCEAN"
	elseif pos.Z >= WorldGrid.ZONES.BEACH_BOARDWALK_Z_MIN then
		district = "VESPUCCI BEACH"
	else
		for _, plot in ipairs(WorldGrid.PLOTS) do
			local hx = plot.size.X * 0.5 + 18
			local hz = plot.size.Z * 0.5 + 18
			if math.abs(pos.X - plot.center.X) <= hx and math.abs(pos.Z - plot.center.Z) <= hz then
				district = plot.district
				break
			end
		end
	end

	local bestStreet = "San Andreas State"
	local bestDist = math.huge
	local secondStreet: string? = nil

	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.EW_ROADS) do
		if pos.X >= r.min - 24 and pos.X <= r.max + 24 then
			local d = math.abs(pos.Z - r.coord)
			if d < bestDist then
				if bestDist < 28 then
					secondStreet = bestStreet
				end
				bestDist = d
				bestStreet = r.name
			elseif d < 28 and r.name ~= bestStreet then
				secondStreet = r.name
			end
		end
	end

	for _, r in ipairs(WorldGrid.NS_ROADS) do
		if pos.Z >= r.min - 24 and pos.Z <= r.max + 24 then
			local d = math.abs(pos.X - r.coord)
			if d < bestDist then
				if bestDist < 28 then
					secondStreet = bestStreet
				end
				bestDist = d
				bestStreet = r.name
			elseif d < 28 and r.name ~= bestStreet then
				secondStreet = r.name
			end
		end
	end

	if secondStreet and bestDist < 24 then
		return district, string.format("%s & %s", bestStreet, secondStreet)
	end
	return district, bestStreet
end

return WorldGrid

DestructionManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	DestructionManager.luau
	Hệ thống Máu Ẩn (PartHealth) & Tự Động Vỡ Vật Lý (Auto-Shatter Engine):
	- Mọi khối vật lý có Destructible = true (tường gạch, dải phân cách K-Rail, cọc tiêu, bờ kè đá,
	  tượng đài, và toàn bộ vỏ/kính/đèn xe hơi) đều mang máu ẩn PartHealth.
	- Khi bị XE ĐỤNG hoặc BỊ SÚNG BẮN đều trừ PartHealth, sẫm màu / nứt kính dần.
	- Ngay khi PartHealth <= 0: TỰ ĐỘNG VỠ TUNG thành các mảnh vật lý 3D văng theo hướng lực tác động,
	  đồng thời kích hoạt sập dây chuyền cho các hàng gạch nằm chồng phía trên (StructuralRow).
]]

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local DestructionManager = {}

local MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS = 180
local activeDebrisCount = 0

local function getDebrisFolder(): Folder
	local f = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris") :: Folder?
	if not f then
		local created = Instance.new("Folder")
		created.Name = "LosSantos_Debris"
		created.Parent = Workspace
		f = created
	end
	return f :: Folder
end

local function spawnTrackedDebris(part: BasePart, lifetime: number)
	if activeDebrisCount >= MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS then
		local folder = getDebrisFolder()
		local children = folder:GetChildren()
		if #children > 0 then
			children[1]:Destroy()
			activeDebrisCount = math.max(0, activeDebrisCount - 1)
		end
	end
	activeDebrisCount += 1
	part.Parent = getDebrisFolder()
	task.delay(lifetime, function()
		if part.Parent then
			part:Destroy()
		end
		activeDebrisCount = math.max(0, activeDebrisCount - 1)
	end)
end

local function ensureBaseColorSaved(part: BasePart)
	if part:GetAttribute("_OrigR") == nil then
		part:SetAttribute("_OrigR", part.Color.R)
		part:SetAttribute("_OrigG", part.Color.G)
		part:SetAttribute("_OrigB", part.Color.B)
	end
end

local function getSavedBaseColor(part: BasePart): Color3
	local r = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("_OrigR")) or part.Color.R
	local g = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("_OrigG")) or part.Color.G
	local b = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("_OrigB")) or part.Color.B
	return Color3.new(r, g, b)
end

-- Tia mảnh vụn nhỏ văng ra mỗi khi đạn găm hoặc xe quệt trúng nhưng chưa vỡ hẳn
local function emitHitChip(hitPos: Vector3, basePart: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	if activeDebrisCount >= MAX_ACTIVE_DEBRIS then
		return
	end
	local chip = Instance.new("Part")
	chip.Name = "ImpactChip"
	chip.Size = Vector3.new(0.32, 0.24, 0.32)
	chip.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitPos)
	chip.Color = basePart.Color
	chip.Material = basePart.Material
	chip.Anchored = false
	chip.CanCollide = false
	chip.CanQuery = false
	chip.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.35 + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(8, 18), math.random(-10, 10))
	chip.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12))
	spawnTrackedDebris(chip, 1.8)
end

-- Vỡ kính / đèn thành hàng loạt mảnh kính trong suốt văng tứ phía
local function shatterGlassOrLight(part: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	local cf = part.CFrame
	local sz = part.Size
	local col = part.Color
	local mat = part.Material
	local transp = math.clamp(part.Transparency, 0.15, 0.55)

	part:Destroy()

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local ox = (math.random() - 0.5) * sz.X * 0.75
		local oy = (math.random() - 0.5) * sz.Y * 0.75
		local oz = (math.random() - 0.5) * sz.Z * 0.75

		local shard = Instance.new("WedgePart")
		shard.Name = "GlassShard_" .. tostring(i)
		shard.Size = Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(sz.X * 0.28, 0.22, 1.3),
			math.clamp(sz.Y * 0.32, 0.22, 1.3),
			math.clamp(sz.Z * 0.28, 0.15, 1.1)
		)
		shard.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(ox, oy, oz) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 3, math.random() * 3, math.random() * 3)
		shard.Color = col
		shard.Material = mat
		shard.Transparency = transp
		shard.Anchored = false
		shard.CanCollide = true
		shard.CanQuery = false
		shard.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.65 + Vector3.new(math.random(-16, 16), math.random(6, 20), math.random(-16, 16))
		shard.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-18, 18), math.random(-18, 18), math.random(-18, 18))
		spawnTrackedDebris(shard, 4.5)
	end
end

-- Tách khối gạch / bê tông / đá thành 4 mảnh vỡ vật lý 3D văng tung toé
local function fractureWorldBlock(part: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	local cf = part.CFrame
	local sz = part.Size
	local col = getSavedBaseColor(part)
	local mat = part.Material
	local parentFolder = part.Parent
	local row = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("StructuralRow")) or 1
	local pos = part.Position

	part:Destroy()

	local subCount = if (sz.X * sz.Y * sz.Z) > 12 then 4 else 2
	for i = 1, subCount do
		local sxSign = if (i % 2 == 0) then 1 else -1
		local szSign = if i > 2 then 1 else -1
		local chunkSz = Vector3.new(
			math.max(0.45, sz.X * 0.46),
			math.max(0.42, sz.Y * 0.72),
			math.max(0.45, sz.Z * 0.46)
		)
		local localOff = Vector3.new(
			sxSign * sz.X * 0.22,
			(i % 2 == 0 and 0.1 or -0.1) * sz.Y,
			szSign * sz.Z * 0.22
		)

		local chunk = Instance.new("Part")
		chunk.Name = "RubbleChunk"
		chunk.Size = chunkSz
		chunk.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(localOff) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(-12, 12)), math.rad(math.random(-18, 18)), 0)
		chunk.Color = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18), 0.14)
		chunk.Material = mat
		chunk.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		chunk.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		chunk.Anchored = false
		chunk.CanCollide = true
		chunk.CanQuery = false
		chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.55
			+ Vector3.new(sxSign * math.random(6, 15), math.random(8, 22), szSign * math.random(6, 15))
		chunk.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(-14, 14), math.random(-10, 10))
		spawnTrackedDebris(chunk, 7.5)
	end

	-- Hiệu ứng sập dây chuyền cho các viên gạch nằm ngay bên trên (StructuralRow + 1)
	if parentFolder then
		local reachX = sz.X * 0.65 + 1.2
		local reachZ = sz.Z * 0.65 + 1.2
		for _, sib in ipairs(parentFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if sib:IsA("BasePart") and sib:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
				local sibRow = tonumber(sib:GetAttribute("StructuralRow")) or 1
				if sibRow == row + 1 then
					if math.abs(sib.Position.X - pos.X) <= reachX and math.abs(sib.Position.Z - pos.Z) <= reachZ then
						task.delay(0.08, function()
							if sib.Parent then
								local maxHp = tonumber(sib:GetAttribute("MaxPartHealth")) or 100
								DestructionManager.damagePart(sib, maxHp * 1.05, sib.Position, Vector3.new(0, -8, 0))
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Bung rời cánh cửa / nắp capo / cản xe khi hết máu ẩn
local function detachVehiclePanel(part: BasePart, impulse: Vector3)
	if part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or part.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
		shatterGlassOrLight(part, impulse)
		return
	end

	local weld = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("WeldConstraint")
	if weld then
		weld:Destroy()
	end

	part:SetAttribute("Destructible", false)
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.Massless = false
	part.Color = getSavedBaseColor(part):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 32), 0.35)
	part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = impulse * 0.5 + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(12, 24), math.random(-12, 12))
	part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-9, 9), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-9, 9))
	spawnTrackedDebris(part, 8.0)
end

-- Xử lý khói đen, lửa cháy & NỔ TUNG XE khi EngineHealth <= 0
function DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(car: Model, amount: number, originImpulse: Vector3?)
	if not car.Parent or car:GetAttribute("_Exploded") == true then
		return
	end
	local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
	if not chassis then
		return
	end

	local maxE = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxEngineHealth")) or 700
	local curE = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("EngineHealth")) or maxE
	local nextE = math.max(0, curE - amount)
	car:SetAttribute("EngineHealth", nextE)

	local ratio = nextE / maxE

	-- Dưới 55% máu động cơ: bốc khói xám dưới nắp capo
	local smoke = chassis:FindFirstChild("EngineSmoke") :: Smoke?
	if ratio <= 0.55 and not smoke then
		local s = Instance.new("Smoke")
		s.Name = "EngineSmoke"
		s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 118, 124)
		s.Opacity = 0.45
		s.RiseVelocity = 7
		s.Size = 3.5
		s.Parent = chassis
		smoke = s
	end

	-- Dưới 25% máu động cơ: khói đen đặc + bốc lửa cam chuẩn GTA V!
	if ratio <= 0.25 then
		if smoke then
			smoke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30)
			smoke.Opacity = 0.78
		end
		if not chassis:FindFirstChild("EngineFire") then
			local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
			fire.Name = "EngineFire"
			fire.Heat = 12
			fire.Size = 7
			fire.Parent = chassis
		end
	end

	-- Hết sạch máu động cơ => NỔ TUNG XE & PHÁ VỠ GẠCH ĐÁ XUNG QUANH!
	if nextE <= 0 then
		car:SetAttribute("_Exploded", true)
		local blastCenter = chassis.Position

		local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
		exp.Position = blastCenter
		exp.BlastRadius = 22
		exp.BlastPressure = 0 -- Tự tính lực văng mượt bằng DestructionManager
		exp.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
		exp.Parent = Workspace

		-- Hất tung người ngồi nếu còn trên ghế
		local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
		if seat and seat.Occupant then
			seat.Occupant.Sit = false
			seat.Occupant:TakeDamage(65)
		end

		-- Bung toàn bộ các mảnh vỏ xe còn lại và nhuộm cháy đen khung sườn
		for _, desc in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				if desc:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true then
					local outDir = (desc.Position - blastCenter)
					local unit = if outDir.Magnitude > 0.1 then outDir.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					detachVehiclePanel(desc, unit * 48 + Vector3.new(0, 22, 0))
				else
					desc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 25, 25)
					desc.Material = Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal
				end
			end
		end

		chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (originImpulse or Vector3.zero) * 0.2 + Vector3.new(0, 32, 0)
		chassis.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-4, 4), math.random(-5, 5), math.random(-4, 4))

		-- Sóng xung kích vụ nổ thổi vỡ gạch / cọc tiêu / dải phân cách xung quanh xe!
		DestructionManager.damageRadius(blastCenter, 20, 220, 58, car)

		Debris:AddItem(car, 10)
	end
end

-- Hàm trung tâm: Trừ máu ẩn (PartHealth) của bất kỳ Part nào khi bị ĐỤNG XE hoặc BỊ BẮN
function DestructionManager.damagePart(
	part: BasePart,
	amount: number,
	hitPos: Vector3?,
	impulseVec: Vector3?
): boolean
	if not part or not part.Parent or amount <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	-- Nếu bắn trực tiếp vào khung gầm/động cơ xe không phải vỏ rời => trừ thẳng EngineHealth!
	local parentCar = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if parentCar and parentCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true and part:GetAttribute("Destructible") ~= true then
		DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(parentCar, amount * 0.85, impulseVec)
		emitHitChip(hitPos or part.Position, part, impulseVec or Vector3.new(0, 12, 0))
		return false
	end

	if part:GetAttribute("Destructible") ~= true then
		return false
	end
	if part:GetAttribute("_Shattered") == true then
		return false
	end

	ensureBaseColorSaved(part)

	local maxHp = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("MaxPartHealth"))
		or tonumber(part:GetAttribute("MaxIntegrity"))
		or 100
	local curHp = tonumber(part:GetAttribute("PartHealth"))
		or tonumber(part:GetAttribute("Integrity"))
		or maxHp

	local nextHp = math.max(0, curHp - amount)
	part:SetAttribute("PartHealth", nextHp)
	part:SetAttribute("Integrity", nextHp)

	local impulse = impulseVec or Vector3.new(0, 14, 0)
	local impactPt = hitPos or part.Position

	-- Nếu thuộc xe hơi, truyền một phần chấn động vào động cơ xe
	if part:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true and parentCar and parentCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
		DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(parentCar, amount * 0.32, impulse)
	end

	if nextHp > 0 then
		-- Chưa hết máu ẩn: hiện vết sẫm màu / rạn kính & tia mảnh vụn nhỏ (KHÔNG hiện thanh máu thô!)
		emitHitChip(impactPt, part, impulse)
		local ratio = nextHp / math.max(1, maxHp)
		local origCol = getSavedBaseColor(part)

		if part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass then
			part.Color = origCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(210, 230, 245), (1 - ratio) * 0.55)
			part.Transparency = math.clamp(0.18 + ratio * 0.25, 0.15, 0.5)
		elseif ratio <= 0.35 then
			part.Color = origCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 28), 0.36)
		elseif ratio <= 0.70 then
			part.Color = origCol:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36), 0.18)
		end
		return false
	end

	-- ĐÃ HẾT SẠCH MÁU ẨN (nextHp <= 0) => TỰ ĐỘNG VỠ TUNG!
	part:SetAttribute("_Shattered", true)

	if part:GetAttribute("VehiclePart") == true then
		detachVehiclePanel(part, impulse)
	elseif part.Material == Enum.Material.Glass or part.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then
		shatterGlassOrLight(part, impulse)
	else
		fractureWorldBlock(part, impulse)
	end

	return true
end

-- Phá huỷ vùng (dùng cho cả Va chạm Mũi Xe Tốc Độ Cao lẫn Vụ Nổ!)
function DestructionManager.damageRadius(
	center: Vector3,
	radius: number,
	maxDamage: number,
	forceMag: number,
	ignoreInstance: Instance?
): number
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local excludeList: { Instance } = { getDebrisFolder() }
	if ignoreInstance then
		table.insert(excludeList, ignoreInstance)
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludeList

	local hitParts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(center, radius, params)
	local brokenCount = 0

	for _, hp in ipairs(hitParts) do
		if hp:IsA("BasePart") then
			local delta = hp.Position - center
			local dist = delta.Magnitude
			local falloff = math.clamp(1 - (dist / (radius + 2.5)), 0.25, 1)
			local dir = if dist > 0.05 then (delta / dist) else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local dmg = maxDamage * falloff
			if DestructionManager.damagePart(hp, dmg, center + dir * math.min(dist, 1.5), dir * (forceMag * falloff)) then
				brokenCount += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return brokenCount
end

return DestructionManager

VehicleManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	VehicleManager.luau
	Điều khiển vật lý lái xe GTA V mượt mà + Xử lý VA CHẠM TỐC ĐỘ CAO trừ máu ẩn (PartHealth):
	- Khi xe tông vào cọc tiêu, dải phân cách K-Rail, tường gạch, bờ kè hoặc xe khác:
	  + Khối bị tông mất máu ẩn theo động lượng -> hết máu tự vỡ tung thành mảnh rời!
	  + Chính cản trước / đèn pha / nắp capo / kính chắn gió của xe cũng mất máu ẩn -> hết máu bung rơi khỏi xe!
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local VehicleBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Vehicles"):WaitForChild("VehicleBuilder"))
local DestructionManager = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DestructionManager"))

local VehicleManager = {}

local trackedCars: { [Model]: boolean } = {}
local partHitCooldown: { [BasePart]: number } = {}
local carSelfHitCooldown: { [Model]: number } = {}

local PRESET_CYCLE = {
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.CrimsonBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.ObsidianGauntlet,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.MidnightBanshee,
	VehicleBuilder.PRESETS.SunsetComet,
}
local playerCarIndex = 0

local function pickVehicleZonePart(car: Model, zone: string): BasePart?
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if not bodyFolder then
		return nil
	end
	local candidates: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(bodyFolder:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
			local z = tostring(ch:GetAttribute("DamageZone") or "")
			if z == zone or (zone == "Front" and z == "Glass") then
				table.insert(candidates, ch)
			end
		end
	end
	if #candidates == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
end

local function updateBrakeLights(car: Model, braking: boolean)
	local bodyFolder = car:FindFirstChild("DestructibleBodywork")
	if not bodyFolder then
		return
	end
	local col = if braking then Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65) else Color3.fromRGB(175, 22, 30)
	for _, nm in ipairs({ "LeftTaillight", "RightTaillight" }) do
		local tl = bodyFolder:FindFirstChild(nm)
		if tl and tl:IsA("BasePart") then
			tl.Color = col
		end
	end
end

function VehicleManager.registerCar(car: Model)
	if trackedCars[car] then
		return
	end
	trackedCars[car] = true

	local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
	local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
	if chassis then
		pcall(function()
			chassis:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end)
	end
	if seat and chassis then
		seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				chassis:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
			end)
		end)
	end
end

function VehicleManager.spawnForPlayer(player: Player): Model?
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil
	end

	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos")
	local fleet = if root then root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles") else nil
	local targetParent: Instance = fleet or Workspace

	-- Xoá xe cá nhân cũ của người chơi nếu còn để tránh rác map
	local oldTag = "PersonalCar_" .. tostring(player.UserId)
	for carModel in pairs(trackedCars) do
		if carModel.Parent and carModel:GetAttribute("OwnerTag") == oldTag then
			carModel:Destroy()
			trackedCars[carModel] = nil
		end
	end

	playerCarIndex = (playerCarIndex % #PRESET_CYCLE) + 1
	local preset = PRESET_CYCLE[playerCarIndex]

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		flatLook = flatLook.Unit
	end

	local spawnPos = hrp.Position + flatLook * 13 + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local spawnCF = CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, spawnPos + flatLook)
	local car = VehicleBuilder.spawn(targetParent, spawnCF, preset)
	car:SetAttribute("OwnerTag", oldTag)
	VehicleManager.registerCar(car)
	return car
end

function VehicleManager.init()
	local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos")
	if root then
		local fleet = root:FindFirstChild("Phase2_Vehicles")
		if not fleet then
			fleet = VehicleBuilder.spawnDefaultFleet(root)
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(fleet:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") and child:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
				VehicleManager.registerCar(child)
			end
		end
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_dt)
		local now = os.clock()

		-- Dọn bảng cooldown cũ định kỳ
		for p, expTime in pairs(partHitCooldown) do
			if not p.Parent or now > expTime then
				partHitCooldown[p] = nil
			end
		end

		for car in pairs(trackedCars) do
			if not car.Parent or car:GetAttribute("_Exploded") == true then
				trackedCars[car] = nil
				continue
			end

			local chassis = car:FindFirstChild("Chassis") :: BasePart?
			local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat") :: VehicleSeat?
			local vf = if chassis then chassis:FindFirstChild("DriveVectorForce") :: VectorForce? else nil
			local av = if chassis then chassis:FindFirstChild("SteerAngularVelocity") :: AngularVelocity? else nil

			if not chassis or not seat or not vf or not av then
				continue
			end

			local vel = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local speed = vel.Magnitude
			car:SetAttribute("CurrentMPH", math.floor(speed * 1.15))

			local cf = chassis.CFrame
			local flatFwd = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
			if flatFwd.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				flatFwd = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			else
				flatFwd = flatFwd.Unit
			end
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
			if flatRight.Magnitude < 0.01 then
				flatRight = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			else
				flatRight = flatRight.Unit
			end

			local fwdSpeed = vel:Dot(flatFwd)
			local latSpeed = vel:Dot(flatRight)
			local mass = chassis.AssemblyMass
			local maxSpeed = tonumber(car:GetAttribute("MaxSpeed")) or 92

			if seat.Occupant then
				local throttle = seat.ThrottleFloat
				local steer = seat.SteerFloat

				-- Lực kéo động cơ + Phanh + Lực bám ngang chống trượt bánh lố
				local driveF = Vector3.zero
				if math.abs(throttle) > 0.04 then
					local targetSpd = if throttle > 0 then (throttle * maxSpeed) else (throttle * maxSpeed * 0.45)
					local gain = if (throttle * fwdSpeed < -2) then 7.2 else 4.4 -- Phanh gấp ăn hơn!
					driveF = flatFwd * ((targetSpd - fwdSpeed) * mass * gain)
				else
					driveF = -flatFwd * (fwdSpeed * mass * 0.95)
				end

				local gripF = -flatRight * (latSpeed * mass * 8.2)
				vf.Force = driveF + gripF

				-- Đánh lái mượt tỉ lệ theo tốc độ lăn bánh
				local moveRatio = math.clamp(math.abs(fwdSpeed) / 9.0, 0, 1)
				local revSign = if fwdSpeed < -1.5 then -1 else 1
				av.MaxTorque = mass * 520
				av.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -steer * 2.45 * moveRatio * revSign, 0)

				updateBrakeLights(car, throttle < -0.1)
			else
				-- Khi không có người lái: hãm trôi tự nhiên để xe đậu đằm trên dốc/lề đường
				vf.Force = -Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * (mass * 2.4)
				av.MaxTorque = 0
				updateBrakeLights(car, false)
			end

			-- QUÉT VA CHẠM TỐC ĐỘ CAO: Xe đụng khối có máu ẩn -> Trừ PartHealth -> Hết máu tự vỡ!
			if speed >= 13.5 then
				local goingForward = fwdSpeed >= -1.0
				local zoneOffsetZ = if goingForward then -8.15 else 8.15
				local zoneName = if goingForward then "Front" else "Rear"
				local sweepCF = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.55, zoneOffsetZ)

				local params = OverlapParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				local debFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if debFolder then { car, debFolder } else { car }

				local hits = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(sweepCF, Vector3.new(7.5, 2.5, 2.4), params)
				local hitSolidObstacle = false

				for _, hp in ipairs(hits) do
					if hp:IsA("BasePart") then
						if hp:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true then
							if not partHitCooldown[hp] then
								partHitCooldown[hp] = now + 0.16
								hitSolidObstacle = true
								local impactDmg = speed * 2.35
								local pushVec = vel * 1.15 + Vector3.new(0, 14, 0)
								DestructionManager.damagePart(hp, impactDmg, hp.Position, pushVec)
							end
						elseif hp.CanCollide and (hp.Position.Y + hp.Size.Y * 0.5) > (cf.Position.Y - 0.35) then
							-- Va vào vách núi / tường cứng cao hơn bậc vỉa hè
							hitSolidObstacle = true
						end
					end
				end

				-- Phản lực làm móp / vỡ đèn pha / cản xe / nắp capo của chính chiếc xe đang tông!
				if hitSolidObstacle and (now > (carSelfHitCooldown[car] or 0)) then
					carSelfHitCooldown[car] = now + 0.22
					local selfPanel = pickVehicleZonePart(car, zoneName)
					if selfPanel then
						DestructionManager.damagePart(
							selfPanel,
							speed * 0.58,
							selfPanel.Position,
							-flatFwd * (speed * 0.35) + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
						)
					else
						DestructionManager.damageVehicleEngine(car, speed * 0.65, vel)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return VehicleManager

WeaponManager.source:
--!strict
--[[
	WeaponManager.luau
	Cấp vũ khí GTA V (Pistol 9mm & Carbine Rifle) cho người chơi để kiểm thử & chiến đấu:
	- Bắn trúng bất kỳ Part nào có máu ẩn (tường gạch, bờ kè, cọc tiêu, dải phân cách, kính/vỏ xe)
	  đều trừ PartHealth thông qua DestructionManager -> hết máu ẩn là TỰ VỠ!
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local DestructionManager = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DestructionManager"))

local WeaponManager = {}

local WEAPON_SPECS = {
	["Pistol 9mm"] = {
		damage = 38,
		cooldown = 0.16,
		range = 300,
		impulse = 36,
		isRifle = false,
	},
	["Carbine Rifle"] = {
		damage = 30,
		cooldown = 0.095,
		range = 380,
		impulse = 44,
		isRifle = true,
	},
}

local lastShotAt: { [Player]: number } = {}

local function buildWeaponTool(toolName: string, isRifle: boolean): Tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = toolName
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool:SetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon", true)
	tool:SetAttribute("AutoFire", isRifle)
	tool:SetAttribute("FireCooldown", if isRifle then 0.10 else 0.17)

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = if isRifle then Vector3.new(0.32, 0.95, 0.45) else Vector3.new(0.28, 0.82, 0.38)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 29, 36)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	handle.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.CanCollide = false
	handle.Parent = tool

	-- Thân súng & Nòng súng chi tiết hàn cố định vào Handle
	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "ReceiverSlide"
	body.Size = if isRifle then Vector3.new(0.34, 0.42, 2.55) else Vector3.new(0.30, 0.34, 1.25)
	body.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.44, if isRifle then -0.85 else -0.36)
	body.Color = if isRifle then Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 48) else Color3.fromRGB(52, 58, 68)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	body.CanCollide = false
	body.Massless = true
	body.Parent = tool

	local wc1 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	wc1.Part0 = handle
	wc1.Part1 = body
	wc1.Parent = body

	local muzzle = Instance.new("Part")
	muzzle.Name = "Muzzle"
	muzzle.Size = Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.35)
	muzzle.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.46, if isRifle then -2.25 else -1.08)
	muzzle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 26)
	muzzle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	muzzle.CanCollide = false
	muzzle.Massless = true
	muzzle.Parent = tool

	local wc2 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	wc2.Part0 = handle
	wc2.Part1 = muzzle
	wc2.Parent = muzzle

	if isRifle then
		local mag = Instance.new("Part")
		mag.Name = "Magazine"
		mag.Size = Vector3.new(0.24, 0.78, 0.36)
		mag.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.05, -0.78) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(14), 0, 0)
		mag.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 30)
		mag.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		mag.CanCollide = false
		mag.Massless = true
		mag.Parent = tool
		local wc3 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		wc3.Part0 = handle
		wc3.Part1 = mag
		wc3.Parent = mag
	end

	return tool
end

local function giveLoadout(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5)
	if not backpack then
		return
	end
	for _, nm in ipairs({ "Pistol 9mm", "Carbine Rifle" }) do
		if not backpack:FindFirstChild(nm) then
			local t = buildWeaponTool(nm, nm == "Carbine Rifle")
			t.Parent = backpack
		end
	end
end

function WeaponManager.init(remotesFolder: Instance)
	local fireRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("WeaponFire") :: RemoteEvent?
	if not fireRemote then
		local created = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		created.Name = "WeaponFire"
		created.Parent = remotesFolder
		fireRemote = created
	end
	local activeFireRemote = fireRemote :: RemoteEvent

	local function hookPlayer(player: Player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.15)
			giveLoadout(player)
		end)
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(giveLoadout, player)
		end
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		hookPlayer(p)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		lastShotAt[p] = nil
	end)

	activeFireRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, originPos, aimPos)
		if typeof(originPos) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(aimPos) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end

		local char = player.Character
		if not char then
			return
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if not tool or tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") ~= true then
			return
		end

		local spec = WEAPON_SPECS[tool.Name]
		if not spec then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastShotAt[player] or 0) < (spec.cooldown * 0.75) then
			return
		end
		lastShotAt[player] = now

		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if not hrp or (originPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude > 22 then
			return
		end

		local dirVec = aimPos - originPos
		if dirVec.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			return
		end
		local rayDir = dirVec.Unit * spec.range

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local deb = Workspace:FindFirstChild("LosSantos_Debris")
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if deb then { char, deb } else { char }

		local result = Workspace:Raycast(originPos, rayDir, params)
		if result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			local hitPart = result.Instance
			local hitModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			local hitHum = if hitModel then hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil

			if hitHum and hitModel ~= char then
				hitHum:TakeDamage(spec.damage * 0.7)
				activeFireRemote:FireClient(player, "hit", false)
			else
				local shattered = DestructionManager.damagePart(
					hitPart,
					spec.damage,
					result.Position,
					dirVec.Unit * spec.impulse + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
				)
				if hitPart:GetAttribute("Destructible") == true or shattered or (hitModel and hitModel:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true) then
					activeFireRemote:FireClient(player, "hit", shattered)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return WeaponManager

local function formatDollars(amount: number): string
	local negative = amount < 0
	local n = math.floor(math.abs(amount))
	local s = tostring(n)
	local formatted = s
	while true do
		local k
		formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		if k == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	return (if negative then "-$" else "$") .. formatted
end

		-- Cập nhật đồng hồ giờ game
		local ct = Lighting.ClockTime
		local hh = math.floor(ct)
		local mm = math.floor((ct - hh) * 60)
		clockChip.Text = string.format("LOS SANTOS • %02d:%02d", hh, mm)

		-- Cập nhật hiệu ứng chớp Sao Truy Nã + Chớp Xanh-Đỏ trên Radar
		local wanted = math.clamp(tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("WantedLevel")) or 0, 0, 5)
		starsRow.Visible = wanted > 0
		if wanted > 0 then
			local pulsePhase = math.floor(os.clock() * 4.2) % 2 == 0
			wantedFlash.BackgroundColor3 = if pulsePhase
				then Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
				else Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246)
			wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.84

			for i = 1, 5 do
				local st = starLabels[i]
				if i <= wanted then
					st.TextTransparency = 0
					st.TextColor3 = if pulsePhase
						then Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
						else Color3.fromRGB(191, 219, 254)
				else
					st.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 36, 46)
					st.TextTransparency = 0.42
				end
			end
		else
			wantedFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end

		local char = localPlayer.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") or not hum then
			return
		end

		-- Máu (Health)
		local hpRatio = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(1, hum.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
		healthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hpRatio, 1)
		healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = if hpRatio < 0.3
			then Color3.fromRGB(220, 56, 56)
			else Color3.fromRGB(86, 186, 86)

		-- Thể lực chạy nhanh (Stamina)
		local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		if isSprinting and moving and stamina > 1 then
			stamina = math.max(0, stamina - 22 * dt)
			hum.WalkSpeed = 24
		else
			stamina = math.min(100, stamina + 16 * dt)
			hum.WalkSpeed = 16
		end
		staminaFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(stamina / 100, 1)

		-- Cuộn & xoay Minimap theo Camera và vị trí người chơi
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camLook = if cam then cam.CFrame.LookVector else Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local camHeadingRad = math.atan2(camLook.X, -camLook.Z)
		local mapRotDeg = -math.deg(camHeadingRad)

		local pos = hrp.Position
		mapPivot.Rotation = mapRotDeg
		mapContent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-pos.X * RADAR_SCALE, -pos.Z * RADAR_SCALE)

		-- Xoay mũi tên người chơi tương đối so với góc xoay Camera
		local charLook = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		local charHeadingRad = math.atan2(charLook.X, -charLook.Z)
		playerBlip.Rotation = math.deg(charHeadingRad - camHeadingRad) + 45

		-- Đưa chữ 'N' (Hướng Bắc = -Z) chạy dọc mép khung chữ nhật Radar
		local northAngle = -camHeadingRad - math.pi / 2
		local nx = math.clamp(0.5 + math.cos(northAngle) * 0.46, 0.06, 0.94)
		local ny = math.clamp(0.5 + math.sin(northAngle) * 0.46, 0.07, 0.93)
		northBadge.Position = UDim2.new(nx, 0, 0, ny * RADAR_H)

		-- Cập nhật đồng hồ tốc độ MPH khi ngồi trên xe GTA V
		local seatPart = hum.SeatPart
		local activeCar = if seatPart then seatPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") else nil
		if activeCar and activeCar:GetAttribute("IsGtaVehicle") == true then
			local mph = tonumber(activeCar:GetAttribute("CurrentMPH")) or 0
			local cname = tostring(activeCar:GetAttribute("VehicleDisplayName") or activeCar.Name)
			carNameTag.Text = string.upper(cname)
			mphLabel.Text = string.format("%d MPH", mph)
			speedoCluster.Visible = true
		else
			speedoCluster.Visible = false
		end

		-- Cập nhật chữ Khu Vực & Tên Đường góc dưới phải
		local distName, stName = WorldGrid.getLocationInfo(pos)
		local locKey = distName .. "|" .. stName
		if locKey ~= lastLocationKey then
			lastLocationKey = locKey
			districtLabel.Text = distName
			streetLabel.Text = stName
		end
	end)

	return screen
end

	hitTick.TextTransparency = 1
	hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	hitTick.Parent = dot

	local tickToken = 0
	fireRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(evt, shattered)
		if evt == "hit" then
			tickToken += 1
			local myT = tickToken
			hitTick.TextColor3 = if shattered
				then Color3.fromRGB(248, 62, 62)
				else Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
			hitTick.TextSize = if shattered then 21 else 15
			hitTick.TextTransparency = 0
			hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
			task.delay(0.14, function()
				if tickToken == myT then
					hitTick.TextTransparency = 1
					hitTick.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	local holdingTrigger = false
	local lastLocalShot = 0

	local function getEquippedGtaWeapon(): Tool?
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		if not char then
			return nil
		end
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		if tool and tool:GetAttribute("IsGtaWeapon") == true then
			return tool
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function tryFireOnce(tool: Tool)
		local cd = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("FireCooldown")) or 0.16
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastLocalShot < cd then
			return
		end
		lastLocalShot = now

		local muzzle = tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle") :: BasePart?
		local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart?
		local origin = if muzzle then muzzle.Position elseif handle then handle.Position else nil
		if not origin then
			return
		end

		local targetPos = mouse.Hit.Position
		local dir = targetPos - origin
		if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			return
		end

		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local char = localPlayer.Character
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if char then { char } else {}
		local res = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir.Unit * 350, params)
		local endPt = if res then res.Position else (origin + dir.Unit * 180)

		drawLocalTracer(origin, endPt)
		fireRemote:FireServer(origin, targetPos)
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			local tool = getEquippedGtaWeapon()
			if tool then
				holdingTrigger = true
				tryFireOnce(tool)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			holdingTrigger = false
		end
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local tool = getEquippedGtaWeapon()
		if tool then
			local loc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(loc.X, loc.Y)
			dot.Visible = true
			if holdingTrigger and tool:GetAttribute("AutoFire") == true then
				tryFireOnce(tool)
			end
		else
			dot.Visible = false
			holdingTrigger = false
		end
	end)
end

return WeaponClient
